'''Crater's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on [[Thriller's Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sai-Ani Kannu]] traveled to the cantina to rendezvous with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] contact, who hired Kannu to protect the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
